captions.text: I turned around in the dark.
But standing behind me was not a monster.
It was ME from tomorrow, clutching an iron crowbar.
He whispered: The government never dropped a bomb.
They tried to burn the rift beneath this mall.
Massive purple rift tendrils erupted from below!
He shouted: Head for the maintenance shaft! Close the loop!
I leaped toward the ladder into the blinding daylight,
just as he slammed the heavy blast door shut forever.
I stumbled onto the quiet street above.
My phone buzzed one last time:
